<assessment>SOURCE is one street-level oblique view showing a tall right-hand tower, stepped planted setbacks descending toward a low connector and left block, pale projecting framing, recessed glazing and outdoor bays, flat roof edges, and a darker lower facade zone. Neighboring buildings and street infrastructure are also visible. Historical images 2–3 are not target evidence.

CURRENT 10–12 retain the principal building connections and show improved tower recesses with visible side returns, soffits, rear glazing and glass guards. However, the left block and connector still carry conspicuous charcoal outward-facing framing where SOURCE shows pale framing around darker recessed components. Canonical views 4–9 provide assembly context; unseen rear elevations and concealed slab-wall contacts cannot establish source fidelity. No definite floating guards or enclosure-piercing slabs are demonstrated. Neighbor/context restoration remains excluded because opposing recorded intents remain unresolved and the supplied scope is invalid.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: CURRENT 10 and 12 retain dark projecting beams and posts across the left block and connector, interrupting SOURCE’s pale structural grid and extending the dark treatment beyond the source-visible lower facade zone.
action: Correct only the finish of the affected outward-facing frame members to the source’s pale tone. Preserve recessed dark components, the darker lower facade zone, existing frame dimensions, repaired tower recesses and completed terrace assemblies.</issue>
<keep>
Pale tower framing surrounding the repaired recessed openings.
Visible tower recess side returns, soffits and set-back glazing.
Low-wing terrace enclosure returns and connected glass guards.
</keep>
